<!--
  You are amazing! Thanks for contributing to our project!
  Please, DO NOT DELETE ANY TEXT from this template! (unless instructed).

## Proposed change
<!--
  Describe the big picture of your changes here to communicate to the
  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the
  additional information section.
-->
As the `Deutsche Bahn` integration is being deprecated, I created a new integration based on the [pyhafas](https://github.com/FahrplanDatenGarten/pyhafas) client.
pyhafas uses the HaFAS API Endpoint and therefore does not use any web scraping.

This integration is based on the deprecated `Deutsche Bahn` integation and is almost backwards compatible to it.

The is also an open issue https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/78233 already opened. With another person showing interest of this integration.

This is my rewrite of the integration to use control flows see https://github.com/home-assistant/core/pull/78260.

## Type of change
<!--
  What type of change does your PR introduce to Home Assistant?
  NOTE: Please, check only 1! box!
  If your PR requires multiple boxes to be checked, you'll most likely need to
  split it into multiple PRs. This makes things easier and faster to code review.
-->

- [ ] Code quality improvements to existing code or addition of tests

## Additional information
<!--
  Details are important, and help maintainers processing your PR.
  Please be sure to fill out additional details, if applicable.
-->

- This PR fixes or closes issue: fixes https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/78233
- This PR is related to issue: 
- Link to documentation pull request: https://github.com/home-assistant/home-assistant.io/pull/24193

pr_comments:
I thought about doing that too, but wasn't sure, because the parsing is done by the `pyhafas` library and in a future update the library could depend on more attributes of the json. Which would require to update the test case.
Therefore I kept them as original as possible.

Hmm, I've had a search around, and it would seem that some other integrations also have files of similar sizes for testing purposes. I guess it is indeed more practical to have actually API responses for testing instead of watering down the result.
It would be great if this integration could be merged this month, as the old Deutsche Bahn integration will be removed next month.

Just to set proper expectations: I don't decide on whether something gets approved or not. I'm just a regular contributor like you. I've tried to play around with the new version, but failed to find the integration in the list of integrations. This might be a problem on my side though, I haven't found the time to fully look into it.

I just checked, the integration did not show in the new version, because the new hass version now generates an `integration.json` with all the integrations. Which had not been generated by me.

I updated to the newest version and generated it.

Why is this not getting merged?
I think, it looks very good and it is very needed change for my dashboard at home because the deutsche bahn integration does not work properly with delays and such.
I think it just takes some time, for a maintainer to look over this, as there are a lot of other open pull requests.

Normally speaking my open review shouldn't cause this to not arrive on the core dev team's radar. But I've freed up some time tomorrow to look into the integration again.

Referring to this PR in the deprecation process would indeed be a good idea to raise awareness of this PR.

Oh, I forgot to mention that there doesn't seem to be a brands icon for Hafas, which is causing a "logo not found" image to show up. It might be worth considering adding HaCon's image as Hafas to the brands project. Additionally, you may want to add a virtual integration entry for Deutsche Bahn, so people can find this integration more easily. I'm not sure how well known "Hafas" is among the general public, but I suspect it is mostly a technical term.
I added virtual integrations, didn't know that was a thing. I will add the logos, to the brands repository, but they have to be merged separately, to be seen here.

Just to mention: I would love to see this integrated! Right now, I am using `rest` sensors to read single points of data from another internal API. But your solution looks like the world of open data I want to live in. :-)

If things do not move here, maybe a more agile alternative could be to set up your integration as a custom integration and publish it on HACS ([documentation for publishing there](https://hacs.xyz/docs/publish/start)). I am not sure I understand what would need to be done for that. And I am also not sure about the policy of HA. (Do they want everything in the core project or do they prefer an ecosystem of custom integrations?)

I was thinking of publishing it into a custom integaration via HACS, but hadn't got the time for it.

Also I am not sure, why the tests are suddenly failing. But it doesn't seem to be anything my code touches.

> Also I am not sure, why the tests are suddenly failing. But it doesn't seem to be anything my code touches

I had that in a PR once, too. And I couldn't make sense of it either. It got merged anyway without anyone asking about the tests. 🤷

Unfortunately I did not have the time and motivation to work on  this any further. @FaserF has created an integration  https://github.com/FaserF/ha-deutschebahn . I am very greatfull for that and it looks great.

issue_context.title: Bahn integration depricated due to HTML scraping, switch to other API
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Due to the HTML scraping of the bahn.de website, the integration is marked for removal in 2022.11. Switching to an API has been suggested before in https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/12773 without success. The used package `schiene` still relies on HTML scraping, but there are other projects now which could fill the gap, e.g.:

- https://github.com/public-transport/hafas-client
- https://github.com/marudor/BahnhofsAbfahrten

Is this integration still being maintained so the removal in 2022.11 could be averted? 

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

2022.09

### What was the last working version of Home Assistant Core?

2022.08

### What type of installation are you running?

Home Assistant Container

### Integration causing the issue

Deutsche Bahn

### Link to integration documentation on our website

https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/deutsche_bahn/

### Diagnostics information

_No response_

_No response_

review_comments: This doesn't seem like an extremely unexpected exception, as it's based on user input. Or did you put it like this because the API hardly ever refuses to return at least one station?

The API seems to always return values. I tried to input a lot of garbage, but there are always station returned. 

Though that probably depends on the hafas API implementation.

It would be best to set `self._attr_unique_id` at this point with [a unique ID](https://developers.home-assistant.io/docs/entity_registry_index/), as that makes it a lot easier to manage the entity. I don't immediately see anything unique that could be used, other than the config entry's id, so that would probably be your best bet.
I added the `self._attr_unique_id`, not sure if that's enough.
